name: Codebase Search
description: Find snippets of code from the codebase most relevant to the search query.

required.name: query
required.description: The search query to find relevant code.

optional.name: explanation
optional.description: One sentence explanation as to why this tool is being used, and how it contributes to the goal.

optional.name: target_directories
optional.description: Glob patterns for directories to search over.

commands.description: Search the codebase for relevant code snippets.

post_conditions: Relevant code snippets are found and returned

error_handling.action: Retry the search with adjusted parameters.

name: Read File
description: Read the contents of a file.

required.name: target_file
required.description: The path of the file to read.

required.name: should_read_entire_file
required.description: Whether to read the entire file.

required.name: start_line_one_indexed
required.description: The one-indexed line number to start reading from (inclusive).

required.name: end_line_one_indexed_inclusive
required.description: The one-indexed line number to end reading at (inclusive).

optional.name: explanation
optional.description: One sentence explanation as to why this tool is being used, and how it contributes to the goal.

error_handling.action: Abort if file does not exist.
